title: SMA crossover long-only, signal at close, fill next open, whole shares
deliverables: daily table [T]: close, sma_fast, sma_slow, position, cash, equity, return
trades table: one row per fill
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T], fast/slow windows, capital C0, fee F, cost c. DITANYAKAN: daily ledger, trade list, metrics (fractions). RUMUS: Core 7 SMA, 11 cross, 12 sizing, 13 costs, 1-6 metrics; toolkit sma_crossover_signals, trade_list, performance_summary. JAWAB: 1) clean prices. 2) SMAs NaN until full. 3) cross up -> BUY at open t+1, cross down -> SELL at open t+1. 4) q = floor((cash-F)/(P(1+c))). 5) mark at close. 6) force close last bar. 7) metrics; check BUY/SELL alternate; write.
formulas: cross up: f_{i-1} <= s_{i-1} and f_i > s_i

title: Golden cross / death cross event detection
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], windows 50/200 (or as stated). DITANYAKAN: dates of golden (up) and death (down) crosses. RUMUS: Core 11 with SMAs; both days defined. JAWAB: 1) SMAs. 2) mask both days non-NaN. 3) up: f_{i-1}<=s_{i-1} & f_i>s_i; down symmetric. 4) write events in date order.
pitfalls: counting the first defined day as a cross

title: EMA crossover with pandas ewm adjust=False
deliverables: daily table: ema_fast, ema_slow, state, position
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], spans. DITANYAKAN: EMA series, state, lagged position. RUMUS: Core 7 a = 2/(span+1), E_0 = P_0; toolkit sma_crossover_signals(ma='ema'). JAWAB: 1) ewm(span, adjust=False). 2) state = fast > slow. 3) position = state.shift(1) (or next-open fills). 4) write.
pitfalls: adjust=True default gives a different series

title: Bollinger band mean-reversion strategy
deliverables: daily table: mid, upper, lower, position
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], window n, k, ddof per text. DITANYAKAN: bands, positions, trades, metrics. RUMUS: Core 9 bands mid +- k sd; toolkit bollinger_bands, bollinger_signals(mode='mean_reversion', exit='mid'). JAWAB: 1) bands (ddof=0 Bollinger/TA-Lib; pandas-style text -> ddof=1). 2) enter long close < lower; exit close >= mid. 3) lag execution. 4) metrics; write.
pitfalls: wrong ddof for the stated library

title: Bollinger breakout strategy
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], n, k. DITANYAKAN: positions from breakout rule and trades. RUMUS: Core 9; toolkit bollinger_signals(mode='breakout'). JAWAB: 1) bands. 2) long when close > upper; exit when close < mid (or as stated). 3) next-bar execution. 4) write.

title: RSI Wilder overbought/oversold strategy
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], n, thresholds lo/hi. DITANYAKAN: RSI series and trades. RUMUS: Core 8 first AG/AL = SMA of first n changes, then avg = (prev(n-1)+x)/n; RSI = 100 - 100/(1+RS); AL=0 -> 100. JAWAB: 1) changes. 2) Wilder recursion from index n. 3) buy when RSI crosses below lo (or < lo), sell > hi. 4) lag; write.
pitfalls: ewm(alpha=1/n) seeded at first value differs early on

title: RSI via ewm(alpha=1/n) variant
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], n; text describes ewm smoothing. DITANYAKAN: RSI series per stated ewm form. RUMUS: Core 8 variant: AG = gains.ewm(alpha=1/n, adjust=False).mean(), same for losses. JAWAB: 1) gains/losses. 2) ewm. 3) RSI. 4) note difference from Wilder SMA seed; write.

title: MACD signal-line crossover
deliverables: daily table: macd, signal, hist, position
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], spans 12/26/9. DITANYAKAN: MACD, signal, histogram, positions. RUMUS: Core 10 MACD = EMA12-EMA26, signal = EMA9(MACD), adjust=False. JAWAB: 1) EMAs. 2) MACD, signal. 3) hist = MACD - signal. 4) long when MACD crosses above signal; lag; write.

title: Cross-sectional 12-1 momentum monthly portfolio
frame: DIKETAHUI: monthly prices or returns [T x N], lookback L, skip S, quantile. DITANYAKAN: momentum portfolio monthly returns and metrics. RUMUS: momentum = prod(1+r over t-L..t-S-1)-1; toolkit momentum_signal(lookback, skip). JAWAB: 1) signal at t using t-12..t-2 (iloc[t-12:t-1]). 2) rank, top/bottom quantile equal weight. 3) hold over t+1. 4) metrics x12; write.
pitfalls: off-by-one in skip window; first valid month t=12

title: Time-series momentum with volatility scaling
deliverables: per-period table: signal, weight, strategy return
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], lookback, target vol, vol estimator. DITANYAKAN: strategy returns. RUMUS: w_t = sign(r_{t-L..t}) * sigma_target/sigma_t; strategy r_{t+1} = mean_i w_i r_{i,t+1}. JAWAB: 1) lookback return. 2) ex-ante vol (EWMA or rolling, known at t). 3) weights. 4) next-period return; write.

title: Trailing stop exit for a long position
deliverables: daily table: peak, stop level, position
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T], entry rule, trail pct. DITANYAKAN: trades with stop exits. RUMUS: Conventions intraday order: fill pending exit at open -> fill entry -> update peak -> evaluate exits/entries on close -> mark. JAWAB: 1) peak from entry fill (or signal-day close if stated). 2) stop = peak(1 - pct). 3) close < stop -> exit next open. 4) write.
pitfalls: updating peak before filling the pending exit

title: Stop-loss / take-profit with risk-based sizing
deliverables: trades table: entry, stop, target, qty, exit reason, pnl
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T], entry signals, risk_pct, stop rule, reward ratio. DITANYAKAN: sized trades and exits. RUMUS: Core 12 q = floor(risk_pct*equity/stop_dist), stop_dist <= 0 -> 0 shares; exit priority as stated. JAWAB: 1) stop from signal-day level. 2) q. 3) evaluate stop and target per bar with stated priority. 4) pnl net of costs; write.
pitfalls: stop distance from fill-day band instead of signal-day

title: Whole-share sizing with fixed fee and bps cost
deliverables: trades table: qty, price, cost, cash after
frame: DIKETAHUI: fill prices, cash, fee F, cost c (bps -> /1e4). DITANYAKAN: quantity, cash flows, trade pnl. RUMUS: Core 12-13 q = floor((cash-F)/(P(1+c))); buy = qP(1+c)+F; sell = qP(1-c)-F; pnl = sell - buy. JAWAB: 1) bps to fraction. 2) q. 3) cash update. 4) check cash >= 0; write.

title: Weight-based rebalancing with turnover costs
deliverables: per-period table: weights, turnover, cost, net return
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], target weights [T x N], cost bps. DITANYAKAN: net portfolio returns and turnover. RUMUS: Core 13 cost_t = sum|w_t - w_{t-1}^drift| bps/1e4; r_net = w_t'r_{t+1} - cost. JAWAB: 1) drifted pre-trade weights (or previous target if text says). 2) turnover. 3) cost on the rebalance period. 4) metrics; write.

title: Close-to-close lagged weights backtest
deliverables: daily table: signal, position, strategy return, equity
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], signal [T]. DITANYAKAN: strategy returns with weight_t earning r_{t+1}. RUMUS: V1 (b): pos = signal.shift(1); r_s = pos*r; toolkit signals_to_positions(lag=1), backtest_positions. JAWAB: 1) r = pct_change, r_0 = 0. 2) pos lag. 3) r_s. 4) equity = C0 prod(1+r_s); write.

title: Performance summary metrics from a return series
deliverables: metrics json: one key per metric (fractions)
frame: DIKETAHUI: strategy returns [T] (r_0=0 included), P, rf. DITANYAKAN: total return, CAGR, ann vol, Sharpe, Sortino, MDD, Calmar. RUMUS: Core 1-6; toolkit performance_summary, cagr, annualized_vol, sharpe, max_drawdown. JAWAB: 1) total = prod(1+r)-1. 2) CAGR ^(P/n). 3) vol ddof=1 sqrt P. 4) Sharpe, Sortino all periods. 5) MDD positive. 6) Calmar; write.
formulas: Sharpe = mean(r - rf)/std(r - rf) sqrt P

title: Sharpe ratio with risk-free rate
deliverables: metrics: sharpe, mean excess, vol excess
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], rf annual (or series), P. DITANYAKAN: annualised Sharpe. RUMUS: Core 3 rf_p = rf/P (simple) unless compounding stated: (1+rf)^(1/P)-1; toolkit sharpe(rf_per_period). JAWAB: 1) rf per period. 2) excess. 3) mean/std ddof=1 * sqrt P. 4) write.

title: Sortino ratio variants
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], MAR, P. DITANYAKAN: Sortino per stated downside definition. RUMUS: Core 4 DD = sqrt(mean(min(r-MAR,0)^2)) over ALL periods (V5 a); variant std of negative returns only. JAWAB: 1) excess vs MAR. 2) downside deviation. 3) Sortino = mean*P/(DD sqrt P). 4) write.
pitfalls: averaging only over negative periods when the default is asked

title: Max drawdown, drawdown series and duration
deliverables: metrics: mdd, peak date, trough date, longest duration
frame: DIKETAHUI: equity [T] or returns, initial capital. DITANYAKAN: drawdown path, MDD (positive), dates, duration. RUMUS: Core 5 peak = cummax(W) including initial capital (V6 a); dd = (peak - W)/peak; toolkit drawdown_series, max_drawdown. JAWAB: 1) wealth with W_0. 2) dd. 3) argmax trough, its peak date. 4) duration = longest run dd>0; write.
pitfalls: sign reported negative when positive asked

title: Calmar ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], P. DITANYAKAN: Calmar. RUMUS: Core 5 Calmar = annual return / MDD with the text's return definition (CAGR default). JAWAB: 1) CAGR. 2) MDD. 3) ratio (MDD=0 -> inf/NaN per text); write.

title: Trade statistics: win rate, profit factor, average trade
deliverables: metrics: num_trades, win_rate, profit_factor, avg_win, avg_loss
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade list with pnl per closed round trip. DITANYAKAN: trade-level statistics. RUMUS: Core 6 win rate = pnl>0 / closed (forced close included); PF = sum wins / |sum losses|. JAWAB: 1) pnl on SELL rows. 2) counts. 3) stats. 4) write.

title: Hit rate of periodic returns
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T] (or while invested). DITANYAKAN: fraction of periods with r>0. RUMUS: Core 6 hit = #(r>0)/#periods (text decides whether only invested periods). JAWAB: 1) choose denominator. 2) ratio. 3) write.

title: Turnover calculation
frame: DIKETAHUI: weights [T x N] or trades with notional and equity. DITANYAKAN: turnover per period and annualised. RUMUS: one-way = sum|dw|/2 or sum|dw| as defined; annualise mean*P. JAWAB: 1) dw. 2) per-period. 3) annualise. 4) write.

title: Trade list output with forced close at last bar
deliverables: trades table: signal_date, exec_date, side, qty, price, cost, pnl
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions [T], fill prices, costs. DITANYAKAN: one row per fill; final open position closed at last close. RUMUS: toolkit trade_list(force_close=True); pnl only on SELL rows. JAWAB: 1) diff positions -> fills. 2) exec_date = next bar. 3) last-bar signal ignored. 4) forced close row. 5) check counts equal; write.

title: Split back-adjustment of prices and volumes
deliverables: daily table: adj open/high/low/close, adj volume
frame: DIKETAHUI: unadjusted OHLCV [T], splits (ex-date, a:b). DITANYAKAN: adjusted series. RUMUS: Core 14 prices before ex-date x b/a, volume x a/b; strictly before; chronological. JAWAB: 1) factor per action. 2) cumulative product backwards. 3) apply. 4) check last row unchanged, close*volume invariant; write.

title: Cash dividend back-adjustment (CRSP style)
frame: DIKETAHUI: unadjusted closes [T], dividends (ex-date, D). DITANYAKAN: adjusted closes. RUMUS: Core 14 factor = (P_prev - D)/P_prev, P_prev = unadjusted close of last day before ex-date; apply strictly before. JAWAB: 1) locate prior trading day (ex on non-trading day -> prior). 2) factor. 3) cumulative backwards. 4) write.

title: Total return index from price and dividends
deliverables: daily table: price return, total return, index
frame: DIKETAHUI: closes [T], dividends per ex-date. DITANYAKAN: total return series and index. RUMUS: TR_t = (P_t + D_t)/P_{t-1} - 1; index = prod(1+TR). JAWAB: 1) align D to ex-date. 2) TR. 3) index from 1. 4) write.

title: Price data cleaning before backtest
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw price rows (unsorted, duplicates, gaps). DITANYAKAN: clean series. RUMUS: Conventions: sort -> drop duplicate dates keep last -> ffill -> dropna. JAWAB: 1) parse dates. 2) sort stable. 3) dedup keep last. 4) ffill. 5) dropna leading. 6) write.

title: Walk-forward parameter optimisation
deliverables: per-fold table: chosen params, oos return
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices [T], param grid, train length W, test length L. DITANYAKAN: chosen params per fold and stitched OOS performance. RUMUS: fit on [t-W, t-1], pick max metric, apply to next L bars; never refit on test data. JAWAB: 1) folds by row counts. 2) grid search in-sample. 3) OOS backtest with chosen params (indicators warmed from prior data). 4) stitch; write.

title: Walk-forward regression forecast and trading
frame: DIKETAHUI: features [T x k], returns [T], window W. DITANYAKAN: OOS forecasts and strategy returns. RUMUS: fit OLS on rows [t-W, t-1] (targets known by t), predict t; toolkit ols. JAWAB: 1) target alignment r_{t+1}. 2) per t fit. 3) pos = sign(forecast). 4) earn next return; write.

title: Month-end and month-start rebalance dates
frame: DIKETAHUI: trading dates [T]. DITANYAKAN: rebalance dates per rule. RUMUS: Conventions: month-end = last trading day present; month-start = first row whose month differs from prior. JAWAB: 1) group by year-month. 2) max/min date. 3) write.

title: Equal-weight portfolio: periodic rebalance vs buy-and-hold drift
deliverables: daily table: portfolio return both variants
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices [T x N], rebalance frequency. DITANYAKAN: returns for rebalanced and drifting portfolios. RUMUS: rebalanced: r_p = mean_i r_i between rebalances using drifted weights w_i,t = w_i,0 prod(1+r_i)/sum. JAWAB: 1) returns. 2) drift weights between dates. 3) reset at rebalance. 4) compare metrics; write.

title: Long-short quantile portfolio backtest
deliverables: per-period table: long, short, spread return
frame: DIKETAHUI: signal [T x N], returns [T x N], q. DITANYAKAN: long, short, spread returns and metrics. RUMUS: rank at t, equal weights, hold over t+1; spread = long - short. JAWAB: 1) drop NaN signals. 2) quantile buckets (ties rule). 3) next-period means. 4) metrics; write.
pitfalls: round floats before ranking to stabilise ties

title: Benchmark-relative metrics: excess, tracking error, information ratio
deliverables: metrics: active return, tracking error, information ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: strategy returns [T], benchmark returns [T], P. DITANYAKAN: annualised active return, TE, IR. RUMUS: a_t = r_t - b_t; TE = std(a, ddof=1) sqrt P; IR = mean(a) P / TE. JAWAB: 1) align. 2) active. 3) annualise. 4) write.

title: CAPM alpha and beta of strategy vs market
frame: DIKETAHUI: strategy and market returns [T], rf. DITANYAKAN: alpha, beta. RUMUS: r - rf = a + b(m - rf) + e; toolkit ols; alpha annual = a P. JAWAB: 1) excess returns. 2) OLS (HAC if asked). 3) annualise alpha. 4) write.
formulas: r - rf = a + b (m - rf) + e

title: Log vs simple returns aggregation
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices [T] or portfolio of assets. DITANYAKAN: cumulative and portfolio returns with correct aggregation. RUMUS: V2: simple returns aggregate across assets (w'r) and compound in time; log returns sum in time; convert r = e^l - 1. JAWAB: 1) compute both. 2) portfolio with simple. 3) time aggregate. 4) write.

title: Annualisation with monthly or weekly data
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T] at frequency f. DITANYAKAN: annualised mean, vol, Sharpe, CAGR. RUMUS: V3 P = 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 252 daily; vol x sqrt P; CAGR ^(P/n). JAWAB: 1) detect frequency. 2) apply P consistently. 3) write.

title: Crypto backtest with 365-day annualisation
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily crypto closes [T] (all calendar days). DITANYAKAN: metrics annualised with 365. RUMUS: V3 (b) P = 365 for 24/7 data. JAWAB: 1) check no gaps. 2) returns. 3) metrics P=365. 4) write.

title: Long/short state strategy with shorting allowed
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices [T], signal rule producing +1/-1. DITANYAKAN: strategy returns with reversals. RUMUS: toolkit sma_crossover_signals(long_only=False), signals_to_positions(lag=1). JAWAB: 1) state. 2) lag. 3) cost on |dpos| (reversal = 2 units). 4) metrics; write.

title: Volatility targeting position sizing
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], target vol, window, leverage cap. DITANYAKAN: scaled strategy returns. RUMUS: L_t = min(cap, sigma*/sigma_hat_t) with sigma_hat known at t; r_s,t+1 = L_t r_t+1. JAWAB: 1) rolling/EWMA vol annualised. 2) leverage lagged. 3) returns. 4) write.

title: Rolling Sharpe ratio series
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], window W, P. DITANYAKAN: rolling Sharpe (NaN until full). RUMUS: mean_W/std_W(ddof=1) sqrt P. JAWAB: 1) rolling mean, std. 2) ratio. 3) write.

title: Probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], benchmark SR*, number of trials K, trial SR variance. DITANYAKAN: PSR and DSR. RUMUS: PSR = N((SR - SR*) sqrt(n-1)/sqrt(1 - g3 SR + (g4-1)/4 SR^2)) with per-period SR; DSR uses SR* = sqrt(V)[(1-gamma)N^{-1}(1-1/K) + gamma N^{-1}(1-1/(K e))]. JAWAB: 1) per-period SR, skew, kurtosis (non-excess). 2) SR*. 3) PSR. 4) write.
formulas: PSR = Phi((SR - SR*) sqrt(n-1)/sqrt(1 - g3 SR + (g4 - 1)/4 SR^2))

title: Cash and shares ledger mark-to-market
deliverables: daily table: cash, shares, close, value, return
frame: DIKETAHUI: fills (date, side, qty, price, cost), closes [T], C0. DITANYAKAN: daily ledger. RUMUS: Core 1 V_t = cash + shares close_t; r_0 = 0; value marks without exit costs. JAWAB: 1) apply fills on exec dates. 2) mark at close. 3) returns. 4) check V_T/V_0 = prod(1+r), cash >= 0; write.

title: Pairs trading z-score spread mean reversion
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices A, B [T], window, entry/exit z. DITANYAKAN: positions and returns. RUMUS: beta from rolling OLS on training window; spread = A - beta B; z = (spread - mean_W)/std_W. JAWAB: 1) rolling beta (no look-ahead). 2) z. 3) enter |z|>z_in short rich/long cheap; exit |z|<z_out. 4) lag; write.

title: Donchian channel breakout
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T], entry n, exit m. DITANYAKAN: positions and trades. RUMUS: upper = max(high over prior n bars, shifted), lower = min(low over prior m bars). JAWAB: 1) rolling with shift(1) to exclude today. 2) enter close > upper. 3) exit close < lower. 4) next open; write.
pitfalls: including the current bar in the channel

title: Signal consumption and pending-order rules
frame: DIKETAHUI: signals [T], cash, prices. DITANYAKAN: trade list honouring consumption rules. RUMUS: Conventions: signal consumed next bar even if 0 shares; never retried; last-bar signal ignored; one position at a time. JAWAB: 1) queue signal. 2) execute next open. 3) drop if 0 shares. 4) write.

title: Stop fill on gap through stop level
deliverables: trades table: exit price, exit reason
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T], stop levels. DITANYAKAN: exit fills when price gaps through stops. RUMUS: intraday stop: if open <= stop fill at open, elif low <= stop fill at stop (as stated). JAWAB: 1) stop set from prior close. 2) check open then low. 3) fill price. 4) write.
formulas: fill = min(open, stop) for long stop

title: Per-share commission plus tick slippage costs
deliverables: trades table: raw price, exec price, commission
frame: DIKETAHUI: fills, tick size, slippage ticks k, commission per share, minimum. DITANYAKAN: costs per trade. RUMUS: exec = P + s k tick; comm = max(min, q c_share). JAWAB: 1) side sign. 2) adjusted price. 3) commission. 4) pnl; write.

title: Exposure / time in market
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions [T]. DITANYAKAN: fraction of bars with nonzero position. RUMUS: exposure = #(pos != 0)/T. JAWAB: 1) count. 2) ratio. 3) write.

title: Monthly and calendar-year returns table
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily returns [T]. DITANYAKAN: compounded monthly and yearly returns. RUMUS: R_m = prod(1+r over month)-1; R_y = prod(1+R_m)-1. JAWAB: 1) group by year, month. 2) compound. 3) pivot. 4) write.

title: Bootstrap confidence interval for Sharpe
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T], B resamples, block length, seed, level. DITANYAKAN: bootstrap CI of annualised Sharpe. RUMUS: resample (stationary/block if stated) -> Sharpe each -> percentiles. JAWAB: 1) rng = default_rng(seed). 2) B resamples. 3) Sharpe. 4) quantiles; write.

title: ATR chandelier trailing stop
deliverables: daily table: tr, atr, stop, position
frame: DIKETAHUI: OHLC [T], n, multiple m. DITANYAKAN: ATR, stop levels, exits. RUMUS: TR = max(H-L, |H-C_prev|, |L-C_prev|); ATR Wilder; stop = highest high since entry - m ATR. JAWAB: 1) TR. 2) ATR recursion. 3) stop. 4) exit on close below; next open; write.
